# package errs

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/iec61850ctl/pkg/errs"
```

Package errs defines the sentinel errors shared by every iec61850ctl layer and the mapping from an error chain to a stable process exit code.

Lower layers classify failures by wrapping one of the sentinels (directly with %w or through [Mark](#func-mark)/[Invalidf](#func-invalidf)); the CLI maps the chain to an exit code with [ExitCode](#func-exitcode). No layer inspects error strings.

## Constants

```go
const (
	ExitOK           = 0   // success
	ExitUsage        = 2   // invalid flags, arguments or input values, missing confirmation
	ExitInvalidInput = 3   // invalid reference, configuration or SCL
	ExitConnection   = 4   // dial, association or connection loss
	ExitTimeout      = 5   // connect or request deadline exceeded
	ExitRejected     = 6   // server rejected the operation
	ExitUnsupported  = 8   // service not supported by the peer or platform
	ExitPermission   = 9   // access denied, authentication failed, no raw-socket permission
	ExitFailure      = 10  // unclassified failure
	ExitNotFound     = 11  // object, file, dataset, report or IED does not exist
	ExitMismatch     = 12  // write verification read-back mismatch
	ExitInterrupted  = 130 // cancelled by SIGINT/SIGTERM (128 + SIGINT)
)
```

Process exit codes. They are part of the CLI contract (see docs/exitcodes.md).

## Variables

```go
var (
	// ErrInvalidInput indicates invalid command-line input or a malformed argument.
	ErrInvalidInput = errors.New("invalid input")

	// ErrInvalidReference indicates an object reference string is malformed or unparseable.
	ErrInvalidReference = errors.New("invalid reference format")

	// ErrInvalidConfig indicates a configuration struct failed validation.
	ErrInvalidConfig = errors.New("invalid configuration")

	// ErrNotFound indicates the requested resource (LD, LN, DO, DA, dataset, report, IED, file) does not exist.
	ErrNotFound = errors.New("resource not found")

	// ErrConnectionFailed indicates the connection to the IEC 61850 server failed or was lost.
	ErrConnectionFailed = errors.New("connection failed")

	// ErrTimeout indicates an operation timed out waiting for a response.
	ErrTimeout = errors.New("operation timed out")

	// ErrPermissionDenied indicates the server denied access to an object or service.
	ErrPermissionDenied = errors.New("permission denied")

	// ErrRejected indicates the server rejected an operation (write, control, RCB update).
	ErrRejected = errors.New("operation rejected")

	// ErrVerifyMismatch indicates a read-back after write did not match the requested value.
	ErrVerifyMismatch = errors.New("verification mismatch")

	// ErrUnsupported indicates the server, platform or this tool does not support the request.
	ErrUnsupported = errors.New("unsupported")
)
```

Sentinel errors. Test with [errors.Is](https://pkg.go.dev/errors#Is).

## Functions

### func ExitCode

```go
func ExitCode(err error) int
```

ExitCode maps an error chain to a process exit code. Classification is by errors.Is/As against this package's sentinels and the go-iec61850, go-mms, context and net error types; error strings are never inspected. Order matters: the most specific classification wins.

### func Invalidf

```go
func Invalidf(format string, args ...any) error
```

Invalidf is shorthand for Newf(ErrInvalidInput, ...).

### func IsObjectNonExistent

```go
func IsObjectNonExistent(err error) bool
```

IsObjectNonExistent reports whether err carries the MMS object-non-existent result: the per-variable data-access error (go-mms or go-iec61850 bulk form) or the access-class service error. ExitCode maps it to ExitNotFound; every other data-access or service error stays ExitRejected.

### func IsTimeout

```go
func IsTimeout(err error) bool
```

IsTimeout reports whether err is a deadline/timeout in any layer.

### func Mark

```go
func Mark(err, sentinel error) error
```

Mark returns err classified as sentinel: errors.Is(Mark(err, s), s) is true, errors.Is/As still see err, and the message is err's message unchanged. Mark(nil, s) returns nil.

### func Newf

```go
func Newf(sentinel error, format string, args ...any) error
```

Newf formats a message and classifies it as sentinel. The message does not repeat the sentinel text.

### func WithExitCode

```go
func WithExitCode(err error, code int) error
```

WithExitCode wraps err so that ExitCode returns code. A nil err stays nil.
